feeding_claim.verbatim: We finish them on a grain-fed diet sourced from local farms, enhancing marbling and flavor.

notes: Homepage describes grass-fed, pasture raised, grain finished beef and pasture-raised pork. Many shop items out of stock. local-delivery not set since no area named.
